title: queue.question@1 (decision kind, floor confirm, safety none): bound args
description: A Claude session's question (inventory Q1, Q2, hole A1). The question as its pane showed it is bound; a dialog's choice is pressed after the pane is read again and still shows it (paneanswer.mjs), and a typed answer reaches that chat only through the service, never from a store file. Preview rows, in order: Session, Project, Question, Choices (optional). Options: choose1..choose8, one per choice (confirm), answer needsText (confirm), decline 'Dismiss' (narrow); deny is narrow (verbFloors).
